Class View.GameLabels

java.lang.Object
Amphipolis.Javadoc.View.GameLabels
Enclosing class:
View
public static class View.GameLabels extends Object
Wrapper class for JLabel to manage game images and text labels easily. Encapsulates initialization, positioning, and styling logic.

  • Constructor Details

    • GameLabels

      public GameLabels(String name, int x, int y, int w, int h, Font font)
      Constructor for GameLabels. Stores configuration data but does not yet create the Swing component. Pre-condition: Parameters match the desired layout configuration. Post-condition: A new GameLabels wrapper is created with the specified properties.
      Parameters:
      name - Name of the asset or label.
      x - X position.
      y - Y position.
      w - Width (-1 for auto-size).
      h - Height (-1 for auto-size).
      font - Font to use (or null for images).

      public void ChangeText(String newText)
      Updates the text content of the label. Pre-condition: The underlying label has been initialized. Post-condition: The label displays the newText.
      Parameters:
      newText - The string to display.

    • addTo

      public void addTo(JPanel panel)
      Instantiates the label (if necessary) and adds it to a standard JPanel. Pre-condition: panel is not null. Post-condition: this.label is initialized and appended to the panel's component list.
      Parameters:
      panel - The target container.

    • addTo

      public void addTo(JLayeredPane pane, Integer layer)
      Instantiates the label (if necessary) and adds it to a JLayeredPane at a specific depth. Pre-condition: pane is not null. Post-condition: this.label is initialized and added to the pane at the specified layer.
      Parameters:
      pane - The target layered container.
      layer - The Integer depth (e.g., JLayeredPane.DEFAULT_LAYER).

    • createLabel

      private void createLabel()
      Internal helper to instantiate and configure the JLabel. Handles loading images from assets or setting font properties based on the constructor fields. Post-condition: this.label is instantiated, bounds are set, and content (Icon or Text) is applied.
